title: serving-runtime-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-28
content:
2026-03-28 - serving runtime scratchpad
Owner: Ethan Li
Context: quick personal notes for bug triage + perf TODOs. Mostly unpolished.

Top priorities (today):
- finish root-cause for slow decode on long-context w/ kv-cache (JIRA-RT-4123)
- reproduce perf regression from canary (03/26) that shows +18% p99 on 8k tokens
- land lightweight kernel fallback for rotary-attn path (PR #987)
- add simple unit test for kv-cache invalidation that reproduces failure case

Triage notes:
- Ticket JIRA-RT-4123: slow decode on 8k+ sequences. Repro steps: run local replay with trace id 2026-03-26-canary-A, model: redwood-v2-13b-8k, batch size 1, pinned seq_len 8192. Observed: p99 latency from 1200ms -> 1420ms after commit 9a3f2d.
  - hypothesis: kernel selection changed for rotary attention; fallback now uses slower elementwise path for certain head sizes.
  - quick check: run ./bin/bench_decode --model redwood-v2-13b-8k --seq 8192 --kernels=all --trace=rt4123
  - note: Marco saw similar in eu-prod logs around 03/26 14:32 (slack thread #serving-runtime).

Perf investigation plan:
- Reproduce locally with docker image redwood/serving:canary-2026-03-26
- Run perf counters (nvprof / Nsight): measure kernel time for attention forward, kv-cache memcpy, and softmax kernels.
- Collect GPU occupancy and warp efficiency for the rotary kernel path.
- Quick experiment: force kernel selection to previous working kernel (env var FORCE_KERNEL=rotary_v1) and compare.
- If that matches baseline, add regression unit test and revert kernel selector heuristics in MLIR pass.

Kernel notes / observations:
- rotary_v2 kernel emits 64-bit index path when seq_len > 4096 which triggers a fallback to a generic path in our runtime. Need to confirm commit that introduced 64-bit indexing (probable: commit 9a3f2d).
- Potential short-term fix: clamp index type to 32-bit when running on GPUs with <= 48GB memory if model_seq <= 16k. Longer fix: update kernel launcher to handle 64-bit without fallback.

Repro steps (detailed):
1) checkout branch reproduce/rt4123 (local)
2) docker build -t redwood/serving:repro-rt4123 . --target runtime
3) run: docker run --gpus all --rm -e FORCE_KERNEL=auto redwood/serving:repro-rt4123 ./bin/bench_decode --model redwood-v2-13b-8k --seq 8192 --batch 1 --trace out/rt4123.json
4) collect: nvprof --profile-child-processes --export-profile out/rt4123.nvprof ./bin/bench_decode ...

Immediate TODOs (actionable):
- [ ] Add unit test for kv-cache invalidation (owner: Priya) - target EOD 2026-03-29.
- [ ] Run repro with FORCE_KERNEL=rotary_v1 and attach traces (owner: Ethan) - today.
- [ ] Open small revert PR for kernel selector heuristics if repro confirms (owner: Marco) - tomorrow.
- [ ] Add logging around index type selection in launcher to make future regressions triageable (owner: Janelle) - block on PR #987 review.

Notes on PR #987 (kernel fallback):
- PR implements a lightweight fallback for older GPUs but introduces extra memcpy when crossing tile boundaries. Marco's bench shows ~5-7% overhead on medium sequences (2k-4k), but major for 8k+. Need to refine logic to avoid memcpy for large sequences.
- Test matrix failing on aarch64-aws-c7g (see CI job 14). Might be unrelated (alignment) but worth checking.

Observability items:
- Add a per-request header in traces that records kernel-id and index-type (32/64) so we can query traces by kernel variant. Low effort: add trace tag in runtime request dispatcher.
- Dashboard: create a short-term panel showing p99 by seq_len buckets: [<=1k, 1k-2k, 2k-4k, 4k-8k, 8k+]. This will help detect regressions quickly.

Random notes / reminders:
- Remind SRE to keep a small dedicated canary pool with same model variant where we can force kernel env vars for A/B testing.
- Check with infra about rolling back canary 03/26 if revert not ready.

Meeting follow-ups:
- Sync w/ Marco at 10:30 to review nvprof output.
- Quick async review w/ Priya on unit test design (kv-cache).

References / links (clips):
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/987
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RT-4123
- Confluence note (kernel design): https://confluence.redwood.internal/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=82451
- Slack thread: #serving-runtime (thread ts: 1711509120.000200)

End of scratchpad.
